{{Top|leg}}
'''Olian Okamie''' was the captain of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operating on the edge of the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. She hired the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] poet [[Toirboggle]] to serve on her ship, originally as a "court jester." He ultimately proved to be a capable [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] who kept track of the loot the pirates had stolen, and even revealed to Okamie that one member of the crew was pilfering from the ship's coffers.
